items.proposed: no IDH selection row (drop A's IDH eligibility row)
items.reason: Eligibility allows 'Glioblastoma, IDH-wild type (WT)' and 'Grade 3 or 4 IDH1/2 mutant astrocytoma', plus oligodendroglioma and 'Other high-grade glioma', so no IDH state is required for entry; IDH only names the eligible histologies and is not a selection biomarker.
With the IDH row dropped, there is no eligibility or enrichment biomarker; the remaining markers (T cell/myeloid ratio, CXCL9/CCL5) are pharmacodynamic.

note: Registered arm intervention lists are inconsistent with arm descriptions (both coders used the descriptions). Both coders coded control_arm_from_other_arms yes (Group B1 as retifanlimab-alone comparator); not queued. D31 check: no change (B7: retifanlimab, non-standard and given in all arms while DFMO is randomised, stays a candidate; C5: tissue/CSF cytokines are PD, not tumour PK).
